words.def_en: A mountain with an opening through which hot rock and gas can escape.
words.example: Today's news uses the word volcano.

words.def_en: A sudden release of hot rock ash and gas from a volcano.
words.example: Today's news uses the word eruption.

words.def_en: A very light grey rock full of air holes formed from volcanic foam.
words.example: Today's news uses the word pumice.

words.def_en: Existing or happening below the surface of the sea.
words.example: Today's news uses the word submarine.

words.def_en: A long narrow raised area such as a line of mountains or hills underwater.
words.example: Today's news uses the word ridge.

words.def_en: Hot liquid rock below the surface of the Earth.
words.example: Today's news uses the word magma.

words.def_en: A large group of things moving together such as a swarm of earthquakes.
words.example: Today's news uses the word swarm.

words.def_en: A machine sent into space that orbits the Earth to collect information.
words.example: Today's news uses the word satellite.

words.def_en: To carefully examine and measure an area or situation.
words.example: Today's news uses the word survey.

words.def_en: A large bowl-shaped hole especially at the top of a volcano.
words.example: Today's news uses the word crater.
